description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'TimesheetProjectActivityUniqueValidationAPI' within the OrangeHRM system. It provides a GET method to validate the uniqueness of a project activity in a specific timesheet by checking for duplicates based on activity and project IDs. The class includes validation rules, authorization checks, and uses traits for permissions and services related to timesheets.
